[h2][b]WELCOME TO FLY WHEEL: MAJOR UPDATE[/b][/h2]
Hey Competitors!, welcome to the turbo-charged realm of Fly Wheel! Get ready to witness sparks flying all over in an insane display of robot mayhem! Today's the day we drop our major update – introducing a new map loaded with extra hurdles for that adrenaline rush. Don't forget to drag your buddies along to join the showdown in online multiplayer mode. Dive into the nitty-gritty of this update by checking out the list below. It's gonna be an electrified battle⚡!

[h2][b]What's New?[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added online multiplayer for up to 4 players
[*] Added chat system
[*] Added camera views
[list]
[*] Shared camera view 
[*] Solo camera view 
[*] Fixed camera view
[/list]
[/list][h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]Free Limited Rewards[/b][/h2]
dive in right now and grab those sweet rewards! It's all waiting for you! 🎉 Don't miss out!

[h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2]

We're going all out to bring you the coolest stuff ahead!  more game modes, new maps, and upgrades to level up your gaming experience! We're all about making life in the game top-notch for you! Get ready for the thrill of new adventures coming your way! 

We're happy to get your thoughts on the Fly Wheel's Major Update! If you run into any bugs or glitches let us to know, and we'll fix it up ASAP. Your feedback's our fuel to keep this awesome journey going strong!
